subject: Model shortlist & token sizing — onboarding plan for Clearview Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Model shortlist & token sizing — onboarding plan for Clearview Health

Hi Anna (and team),

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get Clearview onboarded. Monica and Grace are copied to align CS/implementation.

Quick summary of what we'd like to confirm so we can finalize an implementation handoff: 

- Model shortlist: we want to validate the candidate models for two usage patterns you described (clinical note summarization + patient Q&A). Our initial candidates: 1) Open-ChatXL-32k (accuracy-focused), 2) Mistral-8x-16k (latency/cost balanced), 3) LlamaVariant-13B-q4 (quantized, low-cost).
- Context window: Anna mentioned up to 10k tokens for batch summarization and up to 6k for back-and-forth Q&A. Please confirm maximum observed sequence lengths (input + expected output) per workflow.
- Token volumes: please confirm monthly token estimates. We need 3-bucket traffic: baseline, peak-day, and 95th percentile. I attached a simple token forecast template (clearview_token_forecast_v1.xlsx).
- SLA/latency targets: are you targeting P95 < 500ms for the Q&A path? If different, flag here.

Attachments: clearview_token_forecast_v1.xlsx (token inputs template)

Planned next steps: once we get the token numbers and confirmed context lengths, Monica's team will convert this into a Dedicated sizing recommendation and a short model-runbook for the implementation sprint. Would you be available for a sizing sync on Thursday (Jul 12) or Friday (Jul 13)?

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
From: Anna Lopez <anna@clearviewhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearviewhealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model shortlist & token sizing — onboarding plan for Clearview Health

Ben — thanks and appreciated. Quick answers below; I copied procurement for visibility on any sizing-driven cost questions.

- Context windows: for batch summarization our longest raw notes + target summary is ~9,200 tokens (worst case). For the interactive Q&A path typical convo stacks to ~3,000 tokens but we have occasional threads up to ~6,000 when a clinician posts multiple messages.
- Token volumes (monthly): baseline ~22M tokens, peak-day ~3.8M, 95th percentile day ~2.9M. We generated these from our usage logs — the spreadsheet will help if you need distribution by endpoint.
- SLA: For Q&A P95 < 600ms is realistic for us but we can prioritize P90 < 400ms if that helps sizing.

We are sensitive to cost — procurement will push for a reserved capacity option if it avoids spike pricing. Happy to join a sizing call on Jul 13 after 10am PT.

Anna Lopez
Product Manager, Clearview Health
anna@clearviewhealth.com
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model shortlist & token sizing — onboarding plan for Clearview Health

Thanks Anna — useful data. Quoting the key numbers:

> - Batch summarization max ~9,200 tokens
> - Interactive Q&A typical ~3,000 tokens, spikes up to ~6,000
> - Monthly baseline ~22M tokens, peak-day ~3.8M, 95th ~2.9M

Team — my read and asks: 

1) Model picks: Ben suggested Open-ChatXL-32k, Mistral-8x-16k, and LlamaVariant-13B-q4. Given the 9k+ context need for summarization we should include at least one 32k-capable variant. Proposal: 
   - Primary for summarization: Open-ChatXL-32k (32k context, best quality)
   - Cost-optimized summarization: Mistral-8x-16k with prefix-windowing + document-chunking (we'll need to run a small eval for quality regression)
   - Q&A: LlamaVariant-13B-q4 as low-cost, with fallback to Open-ChatXL-32k for hard queries above 8k tokens or where quality regressions occur.

2) Sizing assumptions: using Anna's numbers, provisional baseline GPU reserved estimate is 2x A100-80GB-equivalent for steady state with burst pool of 1-2 gpus for peak-day. This is a rough engineering ballpark — Karthik, can you validate latency feasibility with the quantized 13B variant for the Q&A P95 target?

3) Operational asks for the kickoff: please send a sample of 50 anonymized notes (we'll use for context-chunking experiments) and map endpoints to expected QPS by hour for a typical day. Anna — if procurement needs an early cost model, Ben can route a cost-vs-latency sketch.

I've attached a quick model-selection rationale (redwood_model_shortlist_recs.pdf) and we'll convert these notes into the implementation runbook during the kickoff.

Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success — Implementation
monica@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model shortlist & token sizing — onboarding plan for Clearview Health

All — thanks. Karthik: flag anything that would block the P95 ~600ms target for the Q&A path on the q4 quant variant. If that looks tight we should plan a warm-fallback to a smaller Open-ChatXL shard for mid-tail queries (and measure cost delta).

Anna — provisional agenda for Jul 13 10:30am PT sizing sync:
- Confirm token forecast inputs (we'll fill the spreadsheet together)
- Validate model shortlist and fallback tiers
- Walk-runbook: data samples, privacy checklist, and expected deliverables for the first 2-week modeling sprint
- Procurement Qs (reserved capacity vs metered)

If Jul 13 10:30 works, I'll send a calendar invite and include the draft runbook and the token-template.

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
